Scenery only: does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame; exactly one foreground character.

Portrait setting: a wide Tokyo scramble crossing on a rainy evening, seen from the near corner. Behind the character, the white stripes shine on wet black asphalt; tall buildings with glowing storefronts and screens surround it, and distant pedestrians under umbrellas wait at the far corners, small and out of focus. Rain falls in fine visible streaks. No readable signs or text.

Portrait lighting - Key: the white glow of a large storefront on the near corner beside the character, softened by rain. Fill: the overcast evening sky, cool gray-blue. Bounce: long streaks of reflected color across the wet stripes and asphalt. Practical: red pedestrian signals on the far corners, headlights and taillights of passing cars, storefronts blurred into unreadable color.
